name: Moving-average pullback in trend
idea: In a trend (the close beyond a rising or falling slow average), wait for the pullback to reach the fast average and for a reversal there with the close back beyond it; the idea is wrong beyond the pullback's extreme.

params.label: Pullback average
params.help: Bars in the fast average the pullback comes back to.

params.label: Trend average
params.help: Bars in the slow average that defines the trend.

params.label: Trend slope over (bars)
params.help: The trend average must be higher (rising trend) or lower (falling trend) than it was this many bars before.

params.label: Reversal on the pullback bar
params.help: Whether the bar that first reaches the fast average may itself be the reversal bar, or the reversal must come on a later bar.

params.label: Reversal within (bars)
params.help: The reversal must come within this many bars after the pullback first reached the fast average.

params.label: The idea has ended
params.help: When the close goes back across the trend average, or no exit signal from this template.
choice_labels: A close back across the trend average

constraints.message: The pullback average must be shorter than the trend average.

later.long: close > MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) AND MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) > Lag(MA(close, $slow, $ma_type), $slope_bars) AND low <= MA(close, $fast, $ma_type) AND low[1] > MA(close, $fast, $ma_type)[1]
later.short: close < MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) AND MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) < Lag(MA(close, $slow, $ma_type), $slope_bars) AND high >= MA(close, $fast, $ma_type) AND high[1] < MA(close, $fast, $ma_type)[1]

same.long: close > MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) AND MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) > Lag(MA(close, $slow, $ma_type), $slope_bars) AND low <= MA(close, $fast, $ma_type) AND low[1] > MA(close, $fast, $ma_type)[1]
same.short: close < MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) AND MA(close, $slow, $ma_type) < Lag(MA(close, $slow, $ma_type), $slope_bars) AND high >= MA(close, $fast, $ma_type) AND high[1] < MA(close, $fast, $ma_type)[1]
